qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Understandability / Established Operating Record, REJECT). Rosebank Industries is a newly formed (July 2024 IPO) acquisition vehicle executing a private-equity style 'Buy, Improve, Sell' turnaround strategy. It completely lacks a multi-cycle public operating track record and an established organic compounding engine.
qualitative.evidence: Founded by former Melrose executives, Rosebank listed as an AIM cash shell in July 2024 before graduating to the Main Market after acquiring North American electrical/industrial assets (ECI, CPM). Lacks multi-cycle consolidated operating history, recurring cash flow visibility, and organic track record as an independent operating company.
